source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Most of the changes look great, but minting still is not functioning.

When I attempt to mint, there is no option to select payment in ETH/USDC/etc, even though my wallet contains both ETH and USDC, and the first mint continues to fail...

My dashboard also continues to say that I own 2 NFTs, but clicking 'read' for these false NFTs does not lead anywhere.

execution.observed_behavior: No payment-method selector was shown even though the connected wallet contained both ETH and USDC.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
When payment supports only ETH (or only USDC), the customer must be informed which currency the payment uses.

However, if both ETH and USDC are available as alternatives, there must be a way to choose between them.

value_updates.single_currency_disclosure_rule: When only ETH or only USDC is supported, inform the customer which currency is used.
value_updates.multi_currency_selection_rule: When ETH and USDC are both supported, allow the customer to choose between them.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I will then include an option that lets them choose.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports completing the accepted ETH payment-option and payment-selector implementation.
